name: USA₮
who_can_redeem: Anchorage Digital Bank clients may redeem covered stablecoins 1:1 for U.S. dollars on the bank platform, subject to client eligibility, compliance, supported-chain and account terms.
redemption_region_notes: Direct issuance and redemption are subject to Anchorage Digital Bank client status, federal banking compliance, supported blockchain availability and current covered-stablecoin terms.
redemption_notes: USA₮ is issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A.; Tether supports the product and brand but is not the issuer.
summary: U.S.-dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. in collaboration with Tether under a U.S. federal banking framework, with a covered-stablecoin reserve trust and monthly third-party reserve attestations.
notes: Record Growth 119→300 Batch AD. Launch day is issuer/brand-announced. Ethereum contract identity is recorded separately; complete future multi-chain history remains subject to ongoing review.
